note: Synthetic responses with known correct outcomes, graded alongside the real run and folded into the fingerprint. They are never counted in any reported statistic. They exist because the recorded models happened to be tidy: not one of them fenced its answer, quoted it, refused, or emitted an uncompilable pattern, so those branches of the extractor were dead weight in the measurement and a sabotage against them could not move the fingerprint. Fabricating model responses into results/ would be dishonest; grading a clearly labelled probe vector is not. One probe, bound-to-its-own-task, exists for a different reason than the rest. Every other probe either binds to the first task or resolves before any pattern is matched, so grading a probe against the wrong task moved nothing and the sabotage suite reported it as an unreachable gate 2. This one carries a correct ZIP pattern, which passes against zip and fails against all eleven other tasks, so the binding between a probe and its task is itself measured rather than assumed.
